data.title: 久远寺有珠 · 药草调配的深夜
data.description: 深夜工作间，她对着一排小药瓶与研钵调配药剂，烛光把她的侧影投在古老的石墙上；动作精准得像仪式，是她「童话咒术与药学」的日常面。
data.action: 深夜工作间，她对着一排小药瓶与研钵调配药剂，烛光把她的侧影投在古老的石墙上
data.promptProse: Alice Kuonji mixes medicine at the late-night workshop table, measuring from small bottles into a mortar with controlled movements. Her dark-blue robe is closed over a high-neck cotton dress, sleeves tied back clear of the ingredients. The medium view includes the orderly bottle row and old stone wall. Candlelight shines through glass shoulders and illuminates her working fingertips, casting a precise profile shadow and taller bottle shapes onto the rough wall.
